

# mycomput.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mycomput-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(mycomput mycomput-cargo mycomput.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
add_dependencies(mycomput psdk)
